versions.content: Service Name Nm_PncBitVectorTxConfirmation Syntax void Nm_PncBitVectorTxConfirmation ( NetworkHandleType NetworkHandle, const uint8 * PncBitVectorPtr, Std_ReturnType result ) Service ID [hex] 0x29 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Non-reentrant for the same NetworkHandle, reentrant otherwise Parameters (in) NetworkHandle Identification of the NM-channel PncBitVectorPtr Pointer to the PNC bit vector which was considered for transmission result E_OK: The PNC bit vector has been transmitted E_NOT_OK: The transmission of the PNC bit vector failed Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value None Description Function called by <Bus>Nms to confirm the state of the transmission for the given PNC bit vector on the given NM-Channel. Available via Nm.h
